name: TronBank

TronBank's Tron contract drained 26.73 million TRX in early May 2019 after a withdrawal path accepted an exact 0.011911 TRX value and released the full balance. Public records disagree on whether the theft happened on 2019-04-29 or 2019-05-03, but they agree on roughly $4.27 million lost. A hidden withdrawal branch in the deployed TronBank contract released the entire balance when msg.value equaled 0x2E87, or 0.011911 TRX. The public record also says the verified TSC source did not match the mainnet logic, but it does not establish who introduced the mismatch.
